notes.title: GameDevDan vs Life Gets Free Update with 21 New Games
notes.content:
GameDevDan vs Life is getting a massive, free update 6 years after its initial launch!

Launched in 2018 with 50 games, the compilation features good, bad and ugly games from my career as a game developer.

In the 6 years since, I've made a bunch more games that weren't added to GameDevDan vs Life... well now that's changed!

[u][b]21 BRAND NEW GAMES, NO EXTRA COST[/b][/u]

This updates brings 21 award-winning new games I've entered into game jams since 2018, including the GMC Jam 39 winner The Frootinis, more games from the HannaH series, and Wham Bam Dan Jam Slam - a fighting game with characters from a bunch of the other games in the pack.

Current owners of the project can download the update for free, and new buyers get the same great price.

[u][b]TRAILER[/b][/u]

[previewyoutube=OXkySUlLJWk;full][/previewyoutube]

I hope you enjoy all the new content!

Best wishes,

Dan

notes.title: GameDevDan vs Life Launches
notes.content:
GameDevDan vs Life launches today with a 17% discount for 1 week only. Get 50 games for under $5 (US) wrapped up in their own neat little launcher.

We're hugely proud to present this back catalogue of games from a 10 year career in game design. Whether you want to play the kooky jam games or the hard-hitting favourites, there's something for everyone in this pack.

Enjoy!
